title: biscutella didyma subsp. columnae
intro: Biscutella didyma subsp. columnae, commonly known as Columned Biscutella, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Columned Biscutella include its ability to relieve coughs, reduce fever, and soothe digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
